title: Tablature extension for W3C MNX (v2)
description: Vendor extension (under `_x.tab`) adding fretted-instrument tablature to MNX: per-note string/fret positions, playing techniques, fingering, and part-level tuning/capo/view declarations. Documents using this extension remain fully valid against the official MNX schema. Design rationale and MusicXML mapping: docs/tab-extension-spec.md. Supersedes guitar-tab-extension.schema.json (v1, namespace `_x.guitar`).

note-id.description: ID of another note in the document (MNX id-reference idiom).

position.description: Where the note is played on the fingerboard. The only truly tab-specific data: notation rendering ignores it; tab rendering requires it (or falls back to a playability heuristic).

string.description: String number. String 1 is the highest-pitched string (E4 on a standard-tuned guitar).

technique.description: Playing techniques. Visible in both notation and tab views; none of them require a position.

amount.description: Bend interval in whole steps (0.5 = half step, 1.0 = whole step).

release.description: True if the bend releases back to the unbent pitch within the note.

target.description: Destination note for shift/legato slides. slide-in/slide-out have no target.

fingering.description: Which finger plays the note. Not tab-specific (kept separable so it can migrate to standard MNX independently).

finger.description: Finger identifier: T, 1, 2, 3, 4 (left hand); p, i, m, a, c (right hand).

note-tab.description: Stored under note._x.tab. All blocks optional and independent: a note may carry a technique or fingering without committing to a fingerboard position.

tuning-entry.description: One string's tuning. The string number is explicit — array order carries no meaning.

part-tab.description: Stored under part._x.tab. Declares the instrument's fingerboard configuration and the part's preferred staff presentation. Tab-ness is a VIEW declaration here — there is no tab clef and no duplicated tab staff; notation and tab are both derived from the same note stream.

tuning.description: Sounding pitch of each open string. If absent, consumers should assume standard guitar tuning (string 1 = E4 … string 6 = E2).

capo.description: Capo fret position (omit or 0 = no capo). A rendering/performance concern: fret numbers in positions are relative to the capo.

staffKind.description: The part's preferred presentation. Consumers may override (e.g. an app's view toggle). If absent, defaults to notation.
